verdict.rationale: Vue ships as an official npm package, and its docs list official companion libraries (Vue Router, Pinia, a Tooling Guide), so developers do build against first-party, documented packages. However, nothing in the evidence describes an SDK in the usual sense, such as API client libraries or multi-language SDKs for a service, so the official ecosystem only approximates the story. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK offering, SDK reference docs or versioned client packages beyond core framework libraries, independent corroboration of SDK use.
